reason: The split payment is clever and EUR 600 a meeting is fine on paper, but I paid an agency before and got nothing, so this month I would take the free 15-company sample and the 30-minute call, not sign. EUR 1,500 up front is still money I lose if the meetings are with people who never buy.
objection: A 'qualified meeting' that happens is not a deal. The last agency also sent me calls; none turned into orders. And one logistics client with 45 meetings tells me nothing about selling manufactured goods to buyers in a new country.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15-company sample names buyers I recognise as real targets I could not reach myself, and a past manufacturing or export client tells me on the phone how many of their meetings became orders.
